newsitem.title: USA: PLC Systems to submit data in the fall.
newsitem.headline: PLC Systems to submit data in the fall.

text.p: PLC Systems Inc said it plans to submit clinical data requested by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in the fall.
In July, an FDA advisory panel rejected PLC's Heart Laser TMR System and requested that the company submit certain follow-up data.
Heart Laser system is used for the treatment of patients with chronic chest pain who do not respond to angioplasty or coronary artery bypass surgery.

To comply with the panel's request for completed data, PLC said it has stepped up its data collection. PLC said it plans meet with the FDA shortly to finalize a plan for the resubmission and expects to provide the data in the fall.
PLC is a cardiac revascularization company developing medical systems and technology.
Shares of PLC gained 1-3/4 to 12-1/8 on the American Stock Exchange.
